newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feed cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feed cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers traded steady early, not tested later after C.M.E. moved limit lower and most buyers pulled off the market. This week's showlists well depleted.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs - couple loads 69.00-70.00; dressed basis mostly 112.00, instances 111.00. (weighted average 111.95).
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1225 lbs - couple loads 69.00-69.50; dressed basis mostly 112.00, instances 111.00. (weighted average 111.96).
Sales Confirmed: 7,300 Last Week: 51,600 Last Year:
9,800 For week: 99,500 Sm Pd Lst Wk: 92,100 Sm Pd
